name: Meta Aiken

timeline.event: Buildings 1 and 2 are nearly complete, but there's still some equipment strewn around the site. We expect around 3 more months needed for commissioning and server installation.
Building 1 is confirmed operational via drone imagery with 8/9 group of coolers with spinning fans. Imagery also confirms all cooling and power infrastructure in place for Building 2.
Building 2 is operational assuming a 3 month lag compared to Building 1.

sources.publisher: Epoch AI, Frontier Data Centers Hub (CC-BY)
sources.quote: Meta Aiken: current power 69 MW; owner Meta.

explain: Meta Aiken is an operating AI data center in Trenton, SC, owned by meta. Epoch AI estimates it draws 69 MW today and 168 MW when finished.
